problem: The current always-on villager ability executes a 10-second timed Malian stealth tree with 6-second recharge; its native villager appearance flickers near a living Resistance HQ.

stock_evidence.fort_aura_ability: stealth_landmark_aura_mal has an empty effect tree
stock_evidence.compiled_state_tree: Data.sga:statetrees/simulation/statetree.bin decoded against official reflect.db. Exactly three native roots use EntityTrack_SetStealthAllowed(true/false): timed activate_stealth_mal, Fort stealth_castle_spawn_forest_mal, and Spy passive_stealth_ayy. The Fort aura is 2D radius 32 via ConstFloatProvider, filters military plus infantry via Condition_UnitClass, and lingers 30 seconds. Its range is hardcoded in the graph rather than sourced from the dummy aura ability. Spy is a DeferredEntity root, is started from its EBPS deferred_action_state_trees, and has no proximity guard.
stock_evidence.ability_patterns: All 819 official ability XMLs cataloged; 245 always_on abilities with a tree, zero always_on abilities with a nonempty ability_activate_deferred_tree.
stock_evidence.entity_extension: Vietnamese villager and working archer, and official Musofadi, have stealth_ext
stock_evidence.scar_api_static_check: mcp__aoe4__check_code: four calls, zero unknown calls, zero low-confidence APIs

unproven: Whether an indefinite camouflage_enable modifier matches the active Malian SetStealthAllowed state tree for enemy visibility, attack reveal, and recloaking; official graphs do not use that modifier as their stealth action.
Whether MUT_Enable with value 1 yields a live camouflage state on a Vietnamese villager.
Whether an applied modifier survives conversion and removes cleanly on death.
diagnostic_setup: Use a separate 0.5.2 diagnostic build, never the accepted baseline package.

In open terrain, select one test Vietnamese villager with the static auto-stealth ability removed only in the diagnostic source; leave a nearby second villager with the original ability as a baseline control.
Build a living Resistance HQ. Keep both villagers stationary 15 m from it; keep an accepted Vietnamese archer available as an activated-stealth control.
Call the included SCAR probe apply/remove functions on the one test villager; do not apply a second stealth source to it.
native_observations: Record Entity_IsCamouflaged and enemy-player visibility for baseline and modifier villager every 0.25 seconds for at least 45 seconds at a fixed 15 m distance; baseline should demonstrate the reported flicker, while the modifier candidate must have no periodic clear/reapply transitions.
Have each stealthed unit perform an attack, record reveal and recloak timing, and compare the modifier villager to the activated archer's accepted behavior.
Move the modifier villager across the 33 m 2D boundary, remove the modifier on exit, and verify camouflage clears without a delayed reactivation; reenter and apply once.
Destroy the last HQ and remove the modifier; with two HQs in range, destroying one must retain the effect until the last eligible HQ is gone.
Check an allied unit and an enemy unit near the HQ; only the owning Vietnamese eligible unit should be affected.
Check new villager spawn, death, cleanup, and archer activation; archer ability bytes and behavior must remain unchanged.
production_gate: No stock graph is a qualified drop-in. The SCAR modifier fixture is exploratory and not the preferred production path because stock stealth uses EntityTrack_SetStealthAllowed. A native diagnostic must first establish a supported persistent ability/deferred-tree lifecycle with 33 m villager eligibility before source patching. A true Entity_IsCamouflaged readback alone is insufficient.
